title: Nitro Fuel
description: A mod that adds Fuel for you and your Inventions. Craft, scrap and weld youself powerfull tools and Items
body:
The Mod aims to add Fuel wich can be used to power up you or your Inventions.

# **This is an early version made with Mcreator. Later releases may have fewer content after I will redo the mod in Java.**

! Currently not everything is working correctly !
## Known issues:

-Lyconium not generating

-Sound problems with Chainsaw

-Hammer getting used up instead of damaged

## Items wich currently dont work:

-Flamethrower

-Nitrolytra

-Nitrobike

-Nitrotruck [+ missing texture]

-Boat Motor

-Nitro Power Hammer [+ missing texture]

-Nitro Power Fist [+ missing texture]

# How to obtain Nitro

1:Locate Pyronium ![Pyronium Ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3db62123ec8279126f6e3f27ec363705c341d516_0.webp)
- Pyronium ore can be found in the overworld and in the Nether.
- Needs Iron Pickaxe to obtain Pyronium clumbs

2:Smelt Iron into Steel![Steel Ingot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/633c5bd3f71e84bedac4501005604c16c9d5f9e8_0.webp)

3:Use a Hammer to turn Steel![Steel Ingot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/633c5bd3f71e84bedac4501005604c16c9d5f9e8_0.webp) into Steel plates ![Steel Plate](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fdd989102532f4fe710de11f27227058f373104f_0.webp)

![Crafting Hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9eaac65e0de6b9dd1cbee4d641fd15b1c84799fb.png)![Making Steel Plates](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0a71a9b9f347250babb4d0317da03ab40e631244.png)

4:Craft a Nitroforge

![Crafting Nitroforge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/32fc6f74bf699520843405773ac3ff00c9a10020.png)

5:Forge Nitro using the Nitroforge

You also need a Nitrotank to store the Nitro, but you can also put it in a Bucket.
![Craft Nitrotank](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b88a66556d95d7176a32d12dc375a8feb3e5bdc1.png)

Using a piece of coal, Pyronium and a Nitrotank/Bucket you can create Nitro!
![Forge Nitro](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0ae5c3fe01df7088290fe8b3cd10b1c199b023f.png)

! Only works with Coal at the moment!

Nitro can also be Upgraded to Hyper Nitro using Lyconium or to Apex Nitro using Velurian Tharnorite in a Nitro Refinery

## Welding

Some items cant be crafted...
Instead, they need to be welded together in multiple steps using the Welding Table.

To use the Welding Table you will need a Welding Torch:

![Craft Welding Torch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/42e43451499624540a2666c73674e71ec5d302cd.png)

As an example on how this feature works, I will now show you how to weld the Nitrolytra![Nitrolytra](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f989ffdf330d9432fd0e2fc6aeae07bff76982ff_0.webp)

# Step 1: Weld an Elytra with 2 Titanium plates:

![Welding1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2acbf35aaaa91b0f3156eb69cb81ae6c6f6abb1.png)

# Step 2: Use the obtained welding piece and add 2 Titanium Tubes and a Nitro Engine:

![Weld2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2b7ba1132426bab635ed35f34066fabb18fa410.png)

# Step 3: Use the obtained Welding piece and add 2 Steel plates:

![Weld3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2074625d1624af6d0b5a474569f24ada49dd88cf.png)

# Step 4: Use the obtained welding piece and add 2 Nitrotanks:

![weld4](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/49eed382d10e1457fb83d81f5d7cbab1bd54d4fb.png)

# Step 5: Use the obtained welding piece and add 2 Exhaust pipes:

![weld5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f1ba6e7af4b62d4b1e34124eae2990b1b7c61a5f.png)

Congratulations!

You are now the proud owner of an Item that sadly doesnt work yet!

![NitrolytraWeldPreview](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f4cbfa55d6f5aebeeccc18ba38d74ef651ce31d_0.webp)

### Other Recipes:
